name: 鳳頭鸊鷉
illustrationTaxon: Podiceps cristatus adult non-breeding (winter) plumage; main image and diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 小鸊鷉小得多（25–29 cm）、頭圓身矮、短鈍喙及淡色眼；繁殖羽有橙褐頰頸。鳳頭鸊鷉大得多（46–61 cm），長頸、長而纖細的淡色喙，冬羽白臉及白前頸。
黑頸鸊鷉體型較小，頭較大、冠較陡、喙較窄尖、紅眼，身形較短而不如鳳頭鸊鷉細長；鳳頭鸊鷉長喙與長頸明顯。

featureNotes: 冬羽白臉白前頸與暗冠、眼至喙的深色線條分明
長而纖細、尖端淡色的喙；比例較兩種易混淆種更長
長身低浮、頸長；與小鸊鷉矮圓體形明顯不同
飛行時內翼前緣與次級飛羽有大片白色

rangeMap.note: Partial broad-range country overview based on HKBWS: breeding across Europe east through western Russia, Central Asia, southern Siberia and Mongolia to northeast China; wintering on open waters around Africa, the Black/Caspian Sea region, northern Indian subcontinent, south China and southern Japan. Highlighted countries are only illustrative broad-range countries, not nationwide occupancy or precise seasonal/subspecies polygons. Hong Kong's winter visitor status is separately described in text.

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read: Category I, common winter visitor in Deep Bay and Starling Inlet, numbers may have declined; 46–61 cm, long low body, relatively long neck and long slender largely pale bill. Winter adult face to above eye and fore-neck white, eye-to-bill stripe and crown dark; most Hong Kong birds are in winter plumage. Global IUCN LC, trend unknown. Broad Eurasian breeding and Afro-Eurasian winter range.
Cornell eBird/Merlin cross-check: large elegant long-necked grebe; breeding plumage has tawny cheeks and black crests; nonbreeding face and neck bright white with dark line through eye.
Full HKBWS Little Grebe account read: 25–29 cm, round head, short blunt bill; adults have dark crown and pale eyes. Breeding plumage orange-brown cheeks/neck and pale yellow gape mark.
Full HKBWS Black-necked Grebe account read: 28–34 cm, larger head, steeper crown, narrower pointed bill, red iris, less dumpy shape; white sides of neck/flanks in winter.
